title: kate-core: Selections (multi-cursor set), grapheme-aware movement, edit fan-out
summary: One cursor is a selection set of size one; there is no single-cursor code path. Selections is a sorted, non-overlapping Vec<Selection> with a primary index. Movement is grapheme-cluster aware and keeps a goal column across vertical moves. Fan-out builds one Transaction from a per-selection edit function, so typing with 40 cursors is one undo entry. Vertical movement here is by logical line; visual-line movement under dynamic wrap belongs to the GUI, which knows the layout.

lane.reason: Pure logic over kate-text with property tests for the sorted/non-overlapping invariant. No GUI involved.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: New crate API. Dependency with justification: unicode-segmentation (grapheme cluster boundaries; char stepping splits emoji and combining marks).

regression_tests.name: selection::tests::normalize_sorts_merges_and_keeps_primary
regression_tests.asserts: For random selection vectors, the result is sorted by min(), no two ranges overlap, and the primary points at the range that absorbed the original primary.

regression_tests.name: movement::tests::right_steps_over_grapheme_clusters
regression_tests.asserts: From offset 0 in 'e\u{301}x' one Right lands after the combining mark (offset 2), not between e and the accent.

regression_tests.name: movement::tests::vertical_move_keeps_goal_column_across_short_lines
regression_tests.asserts: Column 10 on line 0, Down over an empty line, Down again lands on column 10 of line 2 (with tabs expanded at tab_width).

regression_tests.name: fanout::tests::typing_with_many_cursors_is_one_transaction
regression_tests.asserts: insert_text with 40 carets yields one Transaction of 40 edits and 40 carets each advanced by the text length; single caret is the same code path with 1 edit.
